business_problem: Mindgate Solutions needed to rebuild a legacy payments backbone that could not safely scale to national real-time payment volumes or deliver the resilience, compliance, and fraud controls required for continuous digital transactions.
solution_summary: Mindgate Solutions rebuilt its real-time payments platform around Confluent's data streaming platform for Apache Kafka to replace slow batch-oriented processing with a continuous event-driven backbone. The new architecture distributes payment events across services so the company can process and act on transactions in real time for UPI, CBDC, corporate banking, and other digital-finance workloads. Confluent was selected because it could deliver the hyper-scalability needed for millions of transactions per second, multi-region resilience to avoid downtime, and low-latency streaming for compliance and fraud-sensitive operations. The OEM partnership also brought formal design reviews and technical expertise that helped accelerate delivery. With Confluent at the center, Mindgate now runs a national-scale payment infrastructure that supports banks, merchants, and central-bank initiatives without concentrating operational risk in legacy systems.

solution_components.name: Confluent
solution_components.role: Provides Mindgate's enterprise streaming platform for real-time payment event processing.

solution_components.name: Apache Kafka
solution_components.role: Carries continuous transaction streams across the rebuilt payment infrastructure backbone.

data_flow: Payment, account, and activity events stream through Kafka on Confluent across Mindgate's event-driven services, where they are processed continuously for transaction execution, compliance, fraud-sensitive controls, and downstream bank and merchant operations.
business_outcome: Mindgate achieved national-scale payment throughput, reduced operational risk, accelerated time to market, and built the resilient foundation needed to support banks, merchants, and central-bank digital currency programs.
